title: Skill Eval Scenario
description: Defines an evaluation scenario for A/B testing a skill's impact

description.description: Human-readable description of what this scenario tests

task.description: The full task prompt given to the agent

rubric.description: Name of the rubric file (without extension) in the rubrics/ directory

variants.description: Which variants to run (baseline = no skill, with-skill = skill loaded)

timeout.description: Max execution time in seconds per variant (default: 120)
